decisions.summary: A file not yet in gm-copies.json is added with keys: [] and archived; 'a session that matches it later edits its keys'
decisions.why: FR-013 says an inbox file is archived 'its key's rows naming it where it copies a cited source, its keys empty where it copies none', and FR-012 that every file that copies a cited source MUST be matched to its key. D12 (and _archive_ops.process_inbox) gives EVERY new file empty keys, so a new download of a cited source - the usual case, since the GM downloads what a session could not fetch - is archived unmatched and deleted from the inbox, and no procedure document (CLAUDE.md, research/CLAUDE.md, research-doctrine, research-record-rules, page-session-rules) names a matching step; 'later' has no trigger. The consequence defeats FR-012/FR-010's purpose: the key's rows never name the copy, the source page does not list it, and `make archive-find KEY=<k>` does not find it. Matching is not impossible at inbox time (T12 matched all 40 by reading heads; TO-DOWNLOAD.md names the key a download was asked for). Fix: the inbox step matches each new file to its key(s) before it is deleted (a KEY=/match input, or archive-inbox listing each unmatched new file and the procedure requiring the session to record its keys and run the GM=1 sync), and the plan says so; keys: [] stays only for a file judged to copy no cited source.

decisions.summary: A render that fails is retried once; a page that still will not render keeps its served HTML and text as partial

Not a case FR-005 covers (the live page WAS fetched).
